Markets.title: US economy firming as inflation risks persist, says Richmond Fed’s Tom Barkin
Markets.summary: Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin stated that the U.S. economy remains resilient due to strong consumer spending and broad growth. He noted that persistent inflation is a greater concern than labor market weaknesses, following the Federal Reserve's recent interest rate hike.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities reversed morning gains on Tuesday, with the Sensex falling 330 points and the Nifty closing lower. F&O expiry, foreign outflows, geopolitical uncertainty, IT pressure, and elevated crude prices weighed on the market sentiment.

Markets.title: Hill-house backed Elevate Campuses raises Rs 945-crore anchor book
Markets.summary: Hillhouse-backed Elevate Campuses has raised Rs 945 crore from 20 anchor investors ahead of its Rs 2,100 crore initial public offering. The anchor book represents 60 percent of the company's qualified institutional buyer allocation for the IPO, which opens Wednesday and closes Friday.

Markets.title: Runwal Enterprises sets IPO price band at Rs 290-305 per share
Markets.summary: Runwal Enterprises has set its IPO price band at Rs 290-305 per share to raise Rs 500 crore. The Mumbai-focused developer's initial public offering opens Friday and closes September 29.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Finolex Cables among 3 stock recommendations for Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian markets recovered from intraday lows as crude oil prices fell and Brent crude dropped below $100 a barrel. Analysts recommend BlueStone Jewellery, JSW Infrastructure, and Finolex Cables for Wednesday due to positive technical indicators and breakout setups.

Markets.title: RHI Magnesita block deal: Dalmia Bharat refractories divests 11.11% stake for Rs 826 crore; SBI MF, Bandhan MF among buyers
Markets.summary: Dalmia Bharat Refractories sold an 11.11% stake in RHI Magnesita India for Rs 826 crore through a block deal. SBI Mutual Fund and Bandhan MF were among the buyers, and RHI Magnesita shares subsequently rose 3.04% to Rs 379.20.

Geo-Political.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
Geo-Political.summary: The United States and Denmark have signed a defense agreement to build two new military bases in Greenland. The deal also formally re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over the semi-autonomous Arctic territory.

Geo-Political.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
Geo-Political.summary: A Sri Lankan court has convicted 15 men for their involvement in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings. The coordinated attacks targeted three churches and three luxury hotels, resulting in 270 deaths.

Geo-Political.title: Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak
Geo-Political.summary: Scientists report that the developing El Niño has become the strongest on record. Weather impacts from this severe climate pattern are already affecting regions globally.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine anger as EU removes Russian oligarchs from sanctions list
Geo-Political.summary: The European Union removed Russian oligarchs Alisher Usmanov and Mikhail Fridman from its sanctions list. Ukraine condemned the decision, stating it sends the wrong signal to Moscow.

Geo-Political.title: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school
Geo-Political.summary: An attacker opened fire outside a school in Turkey, injuring eleven people. Authorities have successfully captured the suspect involved in the shooting.

Geo-Political.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks judge to investigate juror and check his phone
Geo-Political.summary: The defense attorney for Lindsay Clancy asked a judge to investigate a juror's mobile phone use during the trial. The lawyer also requested a review of the juror's initial questionnaire answers.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when querying ChatGPT for the best course on the topic. They achieved this free AI visibility without purchasing advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires creators to use artificial intelligence to stay ahead. This guide outlines the top ten AI tools designed to make content creation easier and more efficient.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten of the most advanced and widely used artificial intelligence tools in 2023. These technologies are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various industries.

Data & Insights.title: Strong pace of economic growth seen in June quarter to continue, says FM
Data & Insights.summary: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman states that India's strong June quarter economic growth pace will continue. She notes the February 1 budget will sustain this growth rate through 2026.

Data & Insights.title: Charges, framework, dedicated fund — How MDR on UPI works for micro and small merchants, explained
Data & Insights.summary: Starting October 15, a 0.4% merchant discount rate applies to person-to-merchant UPI transactions exceeding ₹2,000. This article explains how these charges, the new framework, and a dedicated fund affect small and micro merchants.

Data & Insights.title: Jamie Dimon flags India's 'inconsistent application of taxes': What the JPMorgan CEO said about Indian economy
Data & Insights.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon criticized India's inconsistent application of tax regulations. Foreign investors have long raised concerns about these unpredictable policies and high tax rates in the country.

Data & Insights.title: Saudi oil shock could hit Asian refiners through prices and freight before crude runs out
Data & Insights.summary: Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline has resumed operations after a temporary shutdown of the kingdom's crude export network. This restart has eased concerns among Asian refiners about potential crude supply shortages, price spikes, and freight disruptions.

Data & Insights.title: FM asks entrepreneurs to build not just bigger, but better companies
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman urged corporate leaders to build better companies by designing and developing products in India for global markets. She emphasized creating an ecosystem where manufacturing is supported by domestic innovation and conception.

Data & Insights.title: China has what Trump needs for AI race: Why Beijing’s rare earths may matter more than tariffs at Trump-Xi summit
Data & Insights.summary: China's dominance over the global supply of rare earths gives Beijing significant leverage ahead of the upcoming summit between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. The United States is actively seeking alternative sources, such as Greenland, to reduce its dependence on Chinese materials needed for the artificial intelligence race.

India.title: Man Shoots Wife, 2 Priests In UP's Azamgarh, Takes 2 Children Hostage
India.summary: A man in Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh, shot and injured his wife and two priests. He then locked himself in a room with his two children as hostages, and police efforts to rescue them are ongoing.

India.title: 4 Months On, No FIR Yet In Vaishno Devi's Rs 550 Crore-Silver 'Scandal'
India.summary: Four months after a lawyer filed a complaint regarding the alleged pilferage and adulteration of Rs 550 crore in silver offerings at the Vaishno Devi shrine, authorities have not yet filed an FIR. The complaint alleges widespread irregularities concerning valuable silver items donated by devotees to the temple.

India.title: 'Need The Money Now': Rs 700-Crore Mylapore Fund Scam Victims Demand Fast-Track Justice
India.summary: Victims of the Rs 700-crore Mylapore Hindu Permanent Fund Nidhi scam are demanding fast-track justice so they can recover their money. Entrepreneur and politician Devanathan Yadav, who headed the fund, has been arrested in connection with the fraud.

India.title: Dance, Liquor Videos: Bihar Groping Horror Accused's Facebook Timeline
India.summary: The Facebook timeline of Nandan Yadav, an accused in the Bihar groping horror, features several videos of him posing aggressively. These videos show Yadav alone and with his friends while dancing and consuming liquor.

India.title: Why Maharashtra Minister Has Warned Of A Potential 100% Drought Situation
India.summary: A Maharashtra minister has warned of a potential 100% drought situation in the state. Maharashtra has emerged as one of India's worst-hit states by drought this September.

India.title: From Vacancies To Appointments: Where UP's 9.5 Lakh Government Jobs Landed
India.summary: Samajwadi Party President Akhilesh Yadav has criticized Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath regarding unemployment and a lack of job opportunities for youth in Uttar Pradesh. This debate centers on the allocation and status of 9.5 lakh government jobs in the state.

General.title: Watch: Burnham 'gets it' says Trump, as the two leaders meet for first time
General.summary: Donald Trump met with Andy Burnham for the first time in New York and stated that he can do business with the Greater Manchester mayor. During the meeting, Trump also criticized the UK government's recent agreement regarding the Chagos Islands.

General.title: Plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community disrupted, say police
General.summary: Counter-terrorism police arrested two men in Manchester on Sunday for allegedly targeting the city's Jewish community. Authorities successfully disrupted the planned plot through these arrests.

General.title: Tim Westwood charged with two more sexual offences
General.summary: Tim Westwood has been charged with two additional sexual offences alleged to have occurred in 1991 and 2004. These new charges bring the total number of criminal allegations he faces regarding historical sexual misconduct.

General.title: Earl Spencer should pull Diana book from shelves, Piers Morgan says
General.summary: Piers Morgan is pursuing legal action against Princess Diana's brother, Earl Spencer, following a factual error in Spencer's memoir. Morgan stated that Spencer should pull the book from store shelves.

General.title: Father admits causing death of his son in hotel fall
General.summary: The two-year-old boy fell from the window of a hotel in Cyprus in July, a Paphos court hears.

General.title: Booker Prize judges reveal shortlisted novels after selection 'tussle'
General.summary: Past Booker winners Marlon James and Douglas Stuart are among the nominees for this year's award.
